edges.parent_basis:
Named as one of the two norms the 1920 edition was made to, in the decree of
approbation printed at the head of that edition: `ad normam Bullae Divino
afflatu et Motu Proprio Abhinc duos annos et subsequentium hujus Sacrae
Congregationis Decretorum`. The edge to the preceding revision is the line's
own order; see `via_unrepresented` on `editio-typica-1920` for what is missing
between them.
